note: Box EVERY symbol in the cell, not just one kind. BOX slurs, ties and hairpins — they are in the detector's class space and an unboxed one trains as background. SKIP only staff lines, stems and beams (classical CV finds those, and YOLO cannot bbox a thin line) and free text (sempre, dolce, tempo marks, instrument names). Slots 1-9 have number keys; the rest are clickable in the pass bar, and the full picker button reaches anything not listed. This pass is what makes a wider --score possible: --score-classes all --score-inspected-for completion only counts cells stamped with this pass name.
